def century_of_year(year):
    """A local history museum is labeling its exhibits by century, and the curator
    wants a small helper to convert the year printed on each artifact's tag into
    the century it belongs to. year is an int with year >= 1. Return the century
    the year belongs to, computed as (year + 99) // 100 with integer floor
    division (year 100 is century 1, year 101 is century 2). So an artifact
    dated year 250 would be filed under century 3, right alongside the other
    third-century pieces in the collection.

    Examples:
        >>> century_of_year(1)
        1
        >>> century_of_year(101)
        2
    """
